mission_01: Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is the most widely used linear dimensionality reduction technique. It finds orthogonal directions (principal components) that capture the maximum variance in the data. By projecting data onto the top components, you can reduce dimensionality while retaining most of the information. PCA is essential for visualization, noise reduction, and speeding up machine learning algorithms. In this mission, you will apply PCA to reduce a 5-dimensional dataset to 2 components, analyze the explained variance, and interpret the results.
